title: Asahina Mafuyu — Like A Heart In My Hands〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Like A Heart In My Hands（4★）

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry for making you be here, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Don't worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: More importantly, I'm glad your dad was willing to understand. This means you can settle in over at my house for the meantime...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Your tea's gone cold...
Let me make a new cup for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, if you're okay with answering...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki, it's me, Mochizuki.
I'm here again as scheduled.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line:
Huh? Asahina...?
What are you doing at Ms. Yoisaki's house...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Oh, right...!
I forgot that she's scheduled to work today...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh no! Don't move, Ms. Yoisaki!
I'll clean this up right away...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
Here's your tea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'll try it now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, I was so surprised when I saw that she was here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I'm sure you were... Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, please. You don't have to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: By the way, Asahina, how are you feeling?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's just...
I heard that you were taking a few days off after catching a cold.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm okay.
It wasn't actually a cold.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, Ms. Mochizuki, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, I will be excusing myself here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll see you at school, Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry, Mafuyu...
I completely forgot that Ms. Mochizuki was scheduled to come over today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's okay.
Someone was bound to find out sooner or later.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But this might make things easier for us...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I felt really bad about having you leave each time Ms. Mochizuki came over...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I do agree with you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Shall we have some of that food Ms. Mochizuki just made?
